出生地: 西德,巴伐利亚,维尔茨堡
简介: Juli Zeh is one of the most prominent voices in contemporary German literature. With a doctorate in law, she serves as an honorary judge at the Constitutional Court of the State of Brandenburg. Her notable literary works include “Corpus Delicti” (2009), “Unterleuten” (2016), and “Über Menschen” (2021). Zeh is also a journalist who writes for such publications as Die Zeit, Frankfurter Allgemeine, and Der Spiegel.
